stem: A digital form saves the wrong room because the technician selected the previous room from a dropdown. What should happen?
choices: Correct the record through the approved electronic correction process and preserve the audit trail
Delete the entire record and recreate it without noting the change
Leave the wrong room because the task was completed
Ask a coworker to edit the database directly
rationale: Electronic records should be corrected transparently so the original entry and authorized correction remain traceable.
